business_problem: RBC Capital Markets needed to speed up document-heavy research and banking workflows so analysts and bankers could deliver faster insights, prepare client materials more efficiently, and answer complex questions without hours of manual review.
solution_summary: RBC Capital Markets expanded its Aiden AI platform with NVIDIA AI Enterprise so specialized agents could automate research and banking workflows without replacing expert judgment. The AidenResearch Platform uses AI agents to generate earnings content, summarize calls, surface insights from data catalogs, and provide real-time access to filings for the Global Research division. RBC is extending the same pattern into AidenBanker, where agents automate pitchbook creation, pre-meeting preparation, and note-taking for bankers. NVIDIA NeMo and NIM are part of the platform stack for model customization and serving, while NVIDIA RAPIDS supports higher-throughput data processing underneath the agent workflows. Together these layers create a reusable agentic platform that sits between capital-markets data sources and end users, reducing manual effort while keeping outputs tied to line-of-business workflows.

solution_components.role: Provides the software platform RBC uses to scale agentic AI across research and banking workflows.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA NeMo
solution_components.role: Supports model customization and enterprise adaptation for RBC's specialized research and banking agents.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA NIM
solution_components.role: Serves the inference layer for the Aiden platform's specialized AI agents.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA RAPIDS
solution_components.role: Accelerates the data-processing workloads that feed the agentic AI experiences used by analysts and bankers.

data_flow: Filings, call transcripts, research catalogs, and banker notes are processed through the Aiden platform, where customized models and agent workflows summarize, generate, and surface relevant insights. Those outputs are then delivered into analyst and banker experiences for report generation, pitchbook creation, pre-meeting preparation, and question answering.
business_outcome: RBC increased document processing capacity by 10x, cut Research QuickTakes generation time by up to 60 percent, moved complex client queries to near-real-time answers, and expanded the Aiden platform to more than 8,000 users across capital-markets teams.
